title: There Is No Neutral Harness: Modern LLM Leaderboards Are Manufactured by Config-Fragile Items
abstract: arXiv:2608.21382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiple-choice benchmarks fix the questions and the correct answers, but not the harness: the order of the options, the wording of the prompt, and whether a language model's answer is read from generated text or from per-option likelihoods. Work on this harness sensitivity reports it as aggregate score variance, leaving unexamined which items the variance falls on and whether they are the items that separate one model from the next. We treat the evaluation harness of large language models (LLMs) as an independent variable and resolve its effect to single items. translated_title: 不存在中立的评估框架：现代大语言模型排行榜由配置敏感项目制造
translated_abstract: 多项选择基准测试固定了问题和正确答案，但未固定评估框架：选项顺序、提示措辞，以及语言模型的答案是从生成文本中读取还是从各选项的似然度中读取。关于这种框架敏感性的研究通常将其报告为总分数方差，而未检验这些方差落在哪些项目上，以及这些项目是否正是区分不同模型的关键项。我们将大语言模型的评估框架视为自变量，并将其影响解析到单个项目。我们引入了“脆弱性网格”：来自4个家族的12个开源指令微调LLM在26种同样合理的框架配置下，回答了来自4个基准测试（ARC、HellaSwag、MMLU、TruthfulQA）的相同3,679个项目，记录了每个模型、项目和配置的一个正确性位。由于项目、权重和贪婪解码均匹配，该比较是配对的。
tldr: 这项研究揭示了现代大语言模型排行榜的排名结果严重依赖于评估框架的细微配置，且这种敏感性集中在特定项目上，这些项目恰恰是决定模型排名的关键，因此不存在真正“中立”的评估框架。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that modern LLM leaderboard rankings are heavily dependent on subtle evaluation harness configurations, with this sensitivity concentrated on specific items that determine model rankings, proving that no truly "neutral" evaluation harness exists.
